kangaroo-ca-2023-g0910-18.prompt: We call a two-digit number **power-less** if none of its digits can be written as an integer to a power greater than 1. kangaroo-ca-2023-g0910-27.prompt: How many three-digit positive integers $x$ are there, such that subtracting the sum of digits of $x$ from $x$ gives a three-digit number whose digits are all the same?

kangaroo-ca-2023-g0910-28.prompt: A stationery shop ordered pens that write red or green, 15 each.
